name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Experimental hidden trajectory prediction: delays cube, robot, and wave inputs predicted to die, then replays them when safe.

buffer-frames.name: Maximum Delay (frames)
buffer-frames.description: Maximum game updates to wait for a safe trajectory. 0 disables predictive buffering; if no safe result appears, the input is sent anyway so it is never silently lost.

prediction-frames.name: Trajectory Lookahead (frames)
prediction-frames.description: How many game updates the hidden player simulates while holding the control input to test whether the path dies. Larger values may cost more time per click.
